## Retrieve a Count of Replays for a Given Issue or Transaction

<a id="opIdgetOrganizationReplayCount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/api/0/organizations/string/replay-count/?query=string&data_source=errors' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/replay-count/`

Return a count of replays for a list of issue or transaction IDs.

The `query` parameter is required. It is a search query that includes exactly one of `issue.id`, `transaction`, or `replay_id` (string or list of strings).

<h3 id="retrieve-a-count-of-replays-for-a-given-issue-or-transaction-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|query|query|string|true|Filters results by using [query syntax](/product/sentry-basics/search/).<br><br>Example: `query=(transaction:foo AND release:abc) OR (transaction:[bar,baz] AND release:def)`<br>|
|data_source|query|string|true|The data source to query replays from.<br><br>* `errors`<br>* `search_issues`<br>* `spans`|
|environment|query|[string]|false|The name of environments to filter by.|
|start|query|string(date-time)|false|The start of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`.|
|end|query|string(date-time)|false|The end of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`.|
|statsPeriod|query|string|false|The period of time for the query, will override the start & end parameters, a number followed by one of:<br>- `d` for days<br>- `h` for hours<br>- `m` for minutes<br>- `s` for seconds<br>- `w` for weeks<br><br>For example, `24h`, to mean query data starting from 24 hours ago to now.|
|project|query|[integer \| string]|false|The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects.<br>For example, the following are valid parameters:<br>- `/?project=1234&project=56789`<br>- `/?project=android&project=javascript-react`<br>- `/?project=-1`<br>|
|project_id_or_slug|query|[string]|false|The legacy project slug filter. Prefer `project`, which accepts project IDs or slugs. Use `$all` to include all available projects. For example, the following are valid parameters:<br>- `/?projectSlug=$all`<br>- `/?projectSlug=android&projectSlug=javascript-react`<br>|
|returnIds|query|boolean|false|If true, return issue IDs rather than counts.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|data_source|errors|
|data_source|search_issues|
|data_source|spans|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "1": 9,
  "2": 0,
  "5": 0,
  "9": 1,
  "10": 29
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-a-count-of-replays-for-a-given-issue-or-transaction-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|

<h3 id="retrieve-a-count-of-replays-for-a-given-issue-or-transaction-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|**additionalProperties**|integer|false|none|none|

<h3 id="list-an-organizations-selectors-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|end|query|string(date-time)|false|This defines the inclusive end of the time series range as an explicit datetime, either in UTC ISO8601 or epoch seconds.Use along with `start` instead of `statsPeriod`.|
|project|query|[integer \| string]|false|A list of project IDs or slugs to filter by.|
|projectSlug|query|[string]|false|A list of project slugs to filter your results by.|
|sort|query|string|false|The field to sort the output by.|

|orderBy|query|string|false|The field to sort the output by.|
|cursor|query|string|false|A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Limit the number of rows to return in the result. Default and maximum allowed is 100.|
|query|query|string|false|Filters results by using [query syntax](/product/sentry-basics/search/).<br><br>Example: `query=(transaction:foo AND release:abc) OR (transaction:[bar,baz] AND release:def)`<br>|

<h1 id="api-reference-spike-protection">Spike Protection</h1>

Endpoints for Spike Protection Notifications

<a href="https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-docs/issues/new/?title=API%20Documentation%20Error:%20/api/integration-platform/&amp;template=api_error_template.md">Found an error? Let us know.</a>

## List Spike Protection Notifications

<a id="opIdlistOrganizationNotificationsActions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/api/0/organizations/string/notifications/actions/' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/notifications/actions/`

Returns all Spike Protection Notification Actions for an organization.

Notification Actions notify a set of members when an action has been triggered through a notification service such as Slack or Sentry.
For example, organization owners and managers can receive an email when a spike occurs.

You can use the `project` query parameter with project IDs or slugs to filter for certain projects.
A legacy project slug query parameter is also supported and takes priority if both are present.

<h3 id="list-spike-protection-notifications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|project|query|[integer \| string]|false|The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects.<br>For example, the following are valid parameters:<br>- `/?project=1234&project=56789`<br>- `/?project=android&project=javascript-react`<br>- `/?project=-1`<br>|
|project_id_or_slug|query|[string]|false|The legacy project slug filter. Prefer `project`, which accepts project IDs or slugs. Use `$all` to include all available projects. For example, the following are valid parameters:<br>- `/?projectSlug=$all`<br>- `/?projectSlug=android&projectSlug=javascript-react`<br>|
|triggerType|query|string|false|Type of the trigger that causes the notification. The only supported value right now is: `spike-protection`|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": 836501735,
  "organizationId": 62848264,
  "integrationId": null,
  "sentryAppId": null,
  "serviceType": "sentry_notification",
  "targetDisplay": "default",
```

`POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/notifications/actions/`

Creates a new Notification Action for Spike Protection.

Notification Actions notify a set of members when an action has been triggered through a notification service such as Slack or Sentry.
For example, organization owners and managers can receive an email when a spike occurs.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "trigger_type": "string",
  "service_type": "string",
  "integration_id": 0,
  "target_identifier": "string",
  "target_display": "string",
  "projects": [
    "string"
  ],
  "sentry_app_id": 0,
  "target_type": "specific"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-spike-protection-notification-action-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|body|body|object|true|none|
|» trigger_type|body|string|true|Type of the trigger that causes the notification. The only supported trigger right now is: `spike-protection`.|
|» service_type|body|string|true|Service that is used for sending the notification.<br>- `email`<br>- `slack`<br>- `sentry_notification`<br>- `pagerduty`<br>- `opsgenie`<br>|

See<br>[List Integrations](https://docs.sentry.io/api/integrations/list-an-organizations-available-integrations/)<br>to retrieve a full list of integrations.<br><br>Required if **service_type** is `slack`, `pagerduty` or `opsgenie`.<br>|
|» target_identifier|body|string|false|ID of the notification target, like a Slack channel ID.<br><br>Required if **service_type** is `slack` or `opsgenie`.<br>|
|» target_display|body|string|false|Name of the notification target, like a Slack channel name.<br><br>Required if **service_type** is `slack` or `opsgenie`.<br>|

|enabled|query|boolean|false|Filter by whether monitors are enabled.|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Limit the number of rows to return in the result. Default and maximum allowed is 100.|
|cursor|query|string|false|A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.|

`DELETE /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/detectors/`

<h3 id="bulk-delete-monitors-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|project|query|[integer \| string]|false|The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects.<br>For example, the following are valid parameters:<br>- `/?project=1234&project=56789`<br>- `/?project=android&project=javascript-react`<br>- `/?project=-1`<br>|
|query|query|string|false|An optional search query for filtering monitors.<br><br>Available fields are:<br>- `name`<br>- `type`: e.g. `error`, `metric_issue`, `issue_stream`<br>- `assignee`: email, username, #team, me, none<br>        |
|sortBy|query|string|false|The property to sort results by. If not specified, the results are sorted by id.<br><br>Available fields are:<br>- `name`<br>- `id`<br>- `type`<br>- `connectedWorkflows`<br>- `latestGroup`<br>- `openIssues`<br><br>Prefix with `-` to sort in descending order.<br>        |
|id|query|[integer]|false|The ID of the monitor you'd like to query.|

        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Users Experiencing Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of               "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br><br>            **Throughput Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"count(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>          ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br> Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"failure_rate()",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br> |» data_sources|body|[object]|false|<br>            The data sources for the metric monitor to use based on what you want to measure.<br><br>            `timeWindow` is measured in seconds. Cron Monitors use schedules instead of this field.<br>            Legacy metric alert rules expressed this value in minutes, so multiply a legacy value<br>            by 60 when migrating it to a monitor. For example, a legacy 5-minute window becomes<br>            `"timeWindow": 300`.<br><br>            **Number of Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count()",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Users Experiencing Errors Metric Monitor**<br>            - `eventTypes`: Any of `error` or `default`.<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate": "count_unique(tags[sentry:user])",<br>                        "dataset" : "events",<br>                        "environment": "prod",<br>                        "eventTypes": ["default", "error"],<br>                        "query": "is:unresolved",<br>                        "queryType": 0,<br>                        "timeWindow": 3600<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br><br>            **Throughput Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"count(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Duration Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(span.duration)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Failure Rate Metric Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"failure_rate()",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Largest Contentful Paint Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are `avg(measurements.lcp)`, `p50(measurements.lcp)`, `p75(measurements.lcp)`, `p95(measurements.lcp)`, `p99(measurements.lcp)`, `p100(measurements.lcp)`, and `percentile(measurements.lcp,x)`, where `x` is your custom percentile.<br><br>            ```json<br>                [<br>                    {<br>                        "aggregate":"p95(measurements.lcp)",<br>                        "dataset":"events_analytics_platform",<br>                        "environment":"prod",<br>                        "eventTypes":["trace_item_span"],<br>                        "query":"is_transaction:true",<br>                        "queryType":1,<br>                        "timeWindow":3600,<br>                        "extrapolationMode":"unknown"<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            ```<br><br>            **Custom Metric Monitor**<br>            - `dataset`: Use `events_analytics_platform`. To query transaction spans, add `is_transaction:true` to `query`.<br>            - `aggregate`: Valid values are:<br>            `avg(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p50(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p75(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p95(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p99(x)`, where x is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `p100(x)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`.<br>            `percentile(x,y)`, where `x` is `transaction.duration`, `measurements.cls`, `measurements.fcp`, `measurements.fid`, `measurements.fp`, `measurements.lcp`, `measurements.ttfb`, or `measurements.ttfb.requesttime`, and `y` is the custom percentile.<br>            `failure_rate()`<br>            `apdex(x)`, where `x` is the value of the Apdex score.<br>            `count()`<br><br>            ```json<br>            [<br>                {<br>                    "aggregate": "p75(measurements.ttfb)",<br>                    "dataset": "events_analytics_platform",<br>                    "environment": "prod",<br>                    "queryType": 1,<br>                    "eventTypes": ["trace_item_span"],<br>                    "query": "is_transaction:true",<br>                    "timeWindow": 3600,<br>                    "extrapolationMode": "unknown"<br>                }<br>            ]<br>            ```<br>|
|» config|body|object|false|<br>            The issue detection type configuration.<br><br><br>            - `detectionType`<br>                - `static`: Threshold based monitor<br>                - `percent`: Change based monitor<br>                - `dynamic`: Dynamic monitor<br>            - `comparisonDelta`: If selecting a **change** detection type, the comparison delta is the time period, in seconds, at which to compare against historical data.<br>            For example, a value of 3600 compares the metric tracked against data 1 hour ago.<br>                - `300`: 5 minutes<br>                - `900`: 15 minutes<br>                - `3600`: 1 hour<br>                - `86400`: 1 day<br>                - `604800`: 1 week<br>                - `2592000`: 1 month<br><br>            **Threshold**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "static"<br>            }<br>            ```<br>            **Change**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "percent",<br>                "comparisonDelta": 3600<br>            }<br>            ```<br>            **Dynamic**<br>            ```json<br>            {<br>                "detectionType": "dynamic"<br>            }<br>            ```<br>        |
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» condition_group|body|object|false|<br>            Issue detection configuration for when to create an issue and at what priority level.<br><br><br>            - `logicType`: `any`<br>            - `type`: Any of `gt` (greater than), `lte` (less than or equal), or `anomaly_detection` (dynamic)<br>            - `comparison`: Any positive integer. This is threshold that must be crossed for the monitor to create an issue, e.g. "Create a metric issue when there are more than 5 unresolved error events".<br>                - If creating a **dynamic** monitor, see the options below.<br>                    - `seasonality`: `auto`<br>                    - `sensitivity`: Level of responsiveness. Options are one of `low`, `medium`, or `high`<br>                    - `thresholdType`: If you want to be alerted to anomalies that are moving above, below, or in both directions in relation to your threshold.<br>                        - `0`: Above<br>                        - `1`: Below<br>                        - `2`: Above and below<br><br>            - `conditionResult`: The issue state change when the threshold is crossed.<br>                - `75`: High priority<br>                - `50`: Low priority<br>                - `0`: Resolved<br><br><br>            **Threshold and Change Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "gt",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "lte",<br>                        "comparison": 10,<br>                        "conditionResult": 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Threshold Monitor with 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 50<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        type: "lte",<br>                        comparison: 2,<br>                        conditionResult: 0<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br><br>            **Dynamic Monitor**<br>            ```json<br>                "logicType": "any",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "anomaly_detection",<br>                        "comparison": {<br>                            "seasonality": "auto",<br>                            "sensitivity": "medium",<br>                            "thresholdType": 2<br>                        },<br>                        "conditionResult": 75<br>                    }<br>                ],<br>                "actions": []<br>            ```<br>        |
|» » id|body|integer|false|none|

## Fetch Alerts

<a id="opIdlistOrganizationWorkflows"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/api/0/organizations/string/workflows/' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

```

`GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/`

Returns a list of alerts for a given organization

<h3 id="fetch-alerts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|sortBy|query|string|false|The field to sort results by. If not specified, the results are sorted by id.<br><br>Available fields are:<br>- `name`<br>- `id`<br>- `dateCreated`<br>- `dateUpdated`<br>- `connectedDetectors`<br>- `actions`<br>- `priorityDetector`<br><br>Prefix with `-` to sort in descending order.<br>    |
|query|query|string|false|An optional search query for filtering alerts.|
|id|query|[integer]|false|The ID of the alert you'd like to query.|
|detector|query|[integer]|false|The IDs of monitors connected to the alerts you'd like to query.|
|project|query|[integer \| string]|false|The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects.<br>For example, the following are valid parameters:<br>- `/?project=1234&project=56789`<br>- `/?project=android&project=javascript-react`<br>- `/?project=-1`<br>|
|per_page|query|integer|false|Limit the number of rows to return in the result. Default and maximum allowed is 100.|
|cursor|query|string|false|A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": "123",
    "name": "Send a notification for high priority issues",
    "organizationId": "1",
    "createdBy": null,
    "dateCreated": "2025-03-18T20:48:55.495059Z",
    "dateUpdated": "2025-03-18T20:48:55.579094Z",
    "triggers": {
      "id": "12345",
      "organizationId": "1",
      "logicType": "any-short",
      "conditions": [
        {
          "id": "2345",
          "type": "new_high_priority_issue",
          "comparison": true,
          "conditionResult": true
```

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/api/0/organizations/string/workflows/' \
```

```bash
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "id": "string",
    "enabled": true,
    "detector_ids": [
      0
    ],
    "config": {
      "property1": null,
      "property2": null
    },

      "id": 0,
      "logic_type": "any",
      "conditions": [
        null
      ]

      {
        "id": 0,
        "logic_type": "any",
        "conditions": [
          null
        ],
        "actions": [

            "property2": null
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "owner": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/`

Creates an alert for an organization

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "id": "string",
  "enabled": true,
  "detector_ids": [
    0
  ],
  "config": {
    "property1": null,
    "property2": null
  },
  "environment": "string",
  "triggers": {
    "id": 0,
    "logic_type": "any",
    "conditions": [
      null
    ]
  },
  "action_filters": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "logic_type": "any",
      "conditions": [
        null
      ],
      "actions": [
        {
          "property1": null,
          "property2": null
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "owner": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-an-alert-for-an-organization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the alert|
|» id|body|string|false|The ID of the existing alert|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether the alert is enabled or disabled|
|» detector_ids|body|[integer]|false|The IDs of the monitors to connect this alert to. Use 'Fetch an Organization's Monitors' to find the IDs.|
|» config|body|object|false|<br>        Typically the frequency at which the alert will fire, in minutes.<br><br>        - `0`: 0 minutes<br>        - `5`: 5 minutes<br>        - `10`: 10 minutes<br>        - `30`: 30 minutes<br>        - `60`: 1 hour<br>        - `180`: 3 hours<br>        - `720`: 12 hours<br>        - `1440`: 24 hours<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "frequency": 60<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        |
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» environment|body|string \| null|false|The name of the environment for the alert to evaluate in|
|» triggers|body|object|false|The conditions on which the alert will trigger. See available options below.<br>        ```json<br>        {<br>            "triggers": {<br>                "organizationId": "1",<br>                "logicType": "any-short",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "first_seen_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "issue_resolved_trigger",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "reappeared_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "regression_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "seer_activity_trigger",<br>                        "comparison": [<br>                            "rca_completed",<br>                            "solution_completed",<br>                            "coding_completed",<br>                            "pr_ready_for_review"<br>                        ],<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            }<br>        }<br>        ```<br>        |
|» » id|body|integer|false|none|
|» » logic_type|body|string|true|* `any`<br>* `any-short`<br>* `all`<br>* `none`|
|» » conditions|body|[object]|false|none|
|» action_filters|body|[object]|false|The filters to run before the action will fire and the action(s) to fire.<br><br>        `logicType` can be one of `any-short`, `all`, or `none`.<br><br>        Below is a basic example. See below for all other options.<br><br>        ```json<br>            "actionFilters": [<br>                {<br>                    "logicType": "any",<br>                    "conditions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "type": "level",<br>                            "comparison": {<br>                                "level": 50,<br>                                "match": "eq"<br>                            },<br>                            "conditionResult": true<br>                        }<br>                    ],<br>                    "actions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "id": "123",<br>                            "type": "email",<br>                            "integrationId": null,<br>                            "data": {},<br>                            "config": {<br>                                "targetType": "user",<br>                                "targetDisplay": null,<br>                                "targetIdentifier": "56789"<br>                            },<br>                            "status": "active"<br>                        }<br>                    ]<br>                }<br>            ]<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Conditions<br><br>        **Issue Age**<br>        - `time`: One of `minute`, `hour`, `day`, or `week`.<br>        - `value`: A positive integer.<br>        - `comparisonType`: One of `older` or `newer`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "age_comparison",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "time": "minute",<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "comparisonType": "older"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Assignment**<br>        - `targetType`: Who the issue is assigned to<br>            - `Unassigned`: Unassigned<br>            - `Member`: Assigned to a user<br>            - `Team`: Assigned to a team<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the user or team from the `targetType`. Enter "" if `targetType` is `Unassigned`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "assigned_to",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "targetType": "Member",<br>                    "targetIdentifier": 123456<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Category**<br>        - `value`: The issue category to filter to.<br>            - `1`: Error issues<br>            - `6`: Feedback issues<br>            - `10`: Outage issues<br>            - `11`: Metric issues<br>            - `12`: DB Query issues<br>            - `13`: HTTP Client issues<br>            - `14`: Front end issues<br>            - `15`: Mobile issues<br>            - `17`: Preprod issues<br>            - `19`: Configuration issues<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_category",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 1<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Frequency**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing how many times the issue has to happen before the alert will fire.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_occurrences",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **De-escalation**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority threshold the issue must de-escalate below.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_deescalating",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Priority**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority the issue must be for the alert to fire.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_greater_or_equal",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Users Affected**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of users that must be affected before the alert will fire.<br>        - `filters`: A list of additional sub-filters to evaluate before the alert will fire.<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of users affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_unique_user_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "filters": [{"key": "foo", "match": "eq", "value": "bar"}],<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of events in an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percent of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Count**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Percentage of sessions affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Percent**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Attribute**<br>        The event's `attribute` value `match` `value`<br><br>        - `attribute`: The event attribute to match on. Valid values are: `message`, `platform`, `environment`, `type`, `error.handled`, `error.unhandled`, `error.main_thread`, `exception.type`, `exception.value`, `user.id`, `user.email`, `user.username`, `user.ip_address`, `http.method`, `http.url`, `http.status_code`, `sdk.name`, `stacktrace.code`, `stacktrace.module`, `stacktrace.filename`, `stacktrace.abs_path`, `stacktrace.package`, `unreal.crash_type`, `app.in_foreground`.<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_attribute",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "match": "co",<br>                    "value": "bar",<br>                    "attribute": "message"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Tagged Event**<br>        The event's tags `key` match `value`<br>        - `key`: The tag value<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "tagged_event",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "key": "level",<br>                    "match": "eq",<br>                    "value": "error"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Latest Release**<br>        The event is from the latest release<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_release",<br>                "comparison": true,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Release Age**<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_adopted_release",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "environment": "production",<br>                    "ageComparison": "older",<br>                    "releaseAgeType": "oldest"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Level**<br>        The event's level is `match` `level`<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `eq`: Equal<br>            - `gte`: Greater than or equal<br>            - `lte`: Less than or equal<br>        - `level`: The event level<br>            - `50`: Fatal<br>            - `40`: Error<br>            - `30`: Warning<br>            - `20`: Info<br>            - `10`: Debug<br>            - `0`: Sample<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "level",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "level": 50,<br>                    "match": "eq"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Actions<br>        A list of actions that take place when all required conditions and filters for the alert are met. See below for a list of possible actions.<br><br><br>        **Notify on Preferred Channel**<br>        - `data`: A dictionary with the fallthrough type option when choosing to notify Suggested Assignees. Leave empty if notifying a user or team.<br>            - `fallthroughType`<br>                - `ActiveMembers`<br>                - `AllMembers`<br>                - `NoOne`<br>        - `config`: A dictionary with the configuration options for notification.<br>            - `targetType`: The type of recipient to notify<br>                - `user`: User<br>                - `team`: Team<br>                - `issue_owners`: Suggested Assignees<br>            - `targetDisplay`: null<br>            - `targetIdentifier`: The id of the user or team to notify. Leave null for Suggested Assignees.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{},<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"user",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"232692"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            },<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{<br>                    "fallthroughType":"ActiveMembers"<br>                },<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"issue_owners",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":""}<br>                ,<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        **Notify on Slack**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the channel to notify in.<br>        `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"slack",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on PagerDuty**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The severity level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"pagerduty",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"default"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Discord**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["tags"]`: Comma separated list of tags to add to the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"discord",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"12345",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"1234",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "tags":"transaction,environment"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on MSTeams**<br>        - `targetIdentifier` - The integration ID associated with the Microsoft Teams team.<br>        - `targetDisplay` - The name of the channel to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"msteams",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"19:a4b3kghaghgkjah357y6847@thread.skype",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on OpsGenie**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the Opsgenie team.<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the Opsgenie team to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The priority level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"opsgenie",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456-Error-Service",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"P3"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Azure DevOps**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"vsts",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira ticket**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"jira",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira Server ticket**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"jira_server",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a GitHub issue**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"github",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                  "additional_fields": {<br>                      "assignee": "",<br>                      "integration": "2345",<br>                      "labels": [],<br>                      "repo": "example-repo",<br>                  },<br>                  "dynamic_form_fields": [<br>                      {<br>                        "choices": [["YourOrg/example-repo", "example-repo"]],<br>                        "default": "YourOrg/example-repo",<br>                        "label": "GitHub Repository",<br>                        "name": "repo",<br>                        "required": true<br>                        "type": "select",<br>                        "updatesForm": true,<br>                        "url": "/extensions/github/search/example-repo/1234567/",<br>                      },<br>                  ],<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        |

## Bulk Delete Alerts

<a id="opIddeleteOrganizationWorkflows"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/api/0/organizations/string/workflows/' \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/`

Bulk delete alerts for a given organization

<h3 id="bulk-delete-alerts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|query|query|string|false|An optional search query for filtering alerts.|
|id|query|[integer]|false|The ID of the alert you'd like to query.|
|project|query|[integer \| string]|false|The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects.<br>For example, the following are valid parameters:<br>- `/?project=1234&project=56789`<br>- `/?project=android&project=javascript-react`<br>- `/?project=-1`<br>|

<h3 id="bulk-delete-alerts-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|None|
|204|No Content|No Content|None|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Unauthorized|None|
|403|Forbidden|Forbidden|None|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
auth_token
</aside>

## Fetch an Alert

<a id="opIdgetOrganizationWorkflow"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://{region}.sentry.io/api/0/organizations/string/workflows/0/' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/workflows/{workflow_id}/`

Returns an alert.

<h3 id="fetch-an-alert-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|workflow_id|path|integer|true|The ID of the alert you'd like to query.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "6789123",
  "name": "My Alert",
```

<h3 id="update-an-alert-by-id-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organization_id_or_slug|path|string|true|The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.|
|workflow_id|path|integer|true|The ID of the alert you'd like to query.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the alert|
|» id|body|string|false|The ID of the existing alert|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether the alert is enabled or disabled|
|» detector_ids|body|[integer]|false|The IDs of the monitors to connect this alert to. Use 'Fetch an Organization's Monitors' to find the IDs.|
|» config|body|object|false|<br>        Typically the frequency at which the alert will fire, in minutes.<br><br>        - `0`: 0 minutes<br>        - `5`: 5 minutes<br>        - `10`: 10 minutes<br>        - `30`: 30 minutes<br>        - `60`: 1 hour<br>        - `180`: 3 hours<br>        - `720`: 12 hours<br>        - `1440`: 24 hours<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "frequency": 60<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        |
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» environment|body|string \| null|false|The name of the environment for the alert to evaluate in|
|» triggers|body|object|false|The conditions on which the alert will trigger. See available options below.<br>        ```json<br>        {<br>            "triggers": {<br>                "organizationId": "1",<br>                "logicType": "any-short",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "first_seen_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "issue_resolved_trigger",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "reappeared_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "regression_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "seer_activity_trigger",<br>                        "comparison": [<br>                            "rca_completed",<br>                            "solution_completed",<br>                            "coding_completed",<br>                            "pr_ready_for_review"<br>                        ],<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            }<br>        }<br>        ```<br>        |
|» » id|body|integer|false|none|
|» » logic_type|body|string|true|* `any`<br>* `any-short`<br>* `all`<br>* `none`|
|» » conditions|body|[object]|false|none|
|» action_filters|body|[object]|false|The filters to run before the action will fire and the action(s) to fire.<br><br>        `logicType` can be one of `any-short`, `all`, or `none`.<br><br>        Below is a basic example. See below for all other options.<br><br>        ```json<br>            "actionFilters": [<br>                {<br>                    "logicType": "any",<br>                    "conditions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "type": "level",<br>                            "comparison": {<br>                                "level": 50,<br>                                "match": "eq"<br>                            },<br>                            "conditionResult": true<br>                        }<br>                    ],<br>                    "actions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "id": "123",<br>                            "type": "email",<br>                            "integrationId": null,<br>                            "data": {},<br>                            "config": {<br>                                "targetType": "user",<br>                                "targetDisplay": null,<br>                                "targetIdentifier": "56789"<br>                            },<br>                            "status": "active"<br>                        }<br>                    ]<br>                }<br>            ]<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Conditions<br><br>        **Issue Age**<br>        - `time`: One of `minute`, `hour`, `day`, or `week`.<br>        - `value`: A positive integer.<br>        - `comparisonType`: One of `older` or `newer`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "age_comparison",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "time": "minute",<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "comparisonType": "older"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Assignment**<br>        - `targetType`: Who the issue is assigned to<br>            - `Unassigned`: Unassigned<br>            - `Member`: Assigned to a user<br>            - `Team`: Assigned to a team<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the user or team from the `targetType`. Enter "" if `targetType` is `Unassigned`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "assigned_to",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "targetType": "Member",<br>                    "targetIdentifier": 123456<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Category**<br>        - `value`: The issue category to filter to.<br>            - `1`: Error issues<br>            - `6`: Feedback issues<br>            - `10`: Outage issues<br>            - `11`: Metric issues<br>            - `12`: DB Query issues<br>            - `13`: HTTP Client issues<br>            - `14`: Front end issues<br>            - `15`: Mobile issues<br>            - `17`: Preprod issues<br>            - `19`: Configuration issues<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_category",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 1<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Frequency**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing how many times the issue has to happen before the alert will fire.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_occurrences",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **De-escalation**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority threshold the issue must de-escalate below.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_deescalating",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Priority**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority the issue must be for the alert to fire.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_greater_or_equal",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Users Affected**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of users that must be affected before the alert will fire.<br>        - `filters`: A list of additional sub-filters to evaluate before the alert will fire.<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of users affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_unique_user_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "filters": [{"key": "foo", "match": "eq", "value": "bar"}],<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of events in an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percent of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Count**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Percentage of sessions affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Percent**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Attribute**<br>        The event's `attribute` value `match` `value`<br><br>        - `attribute`: The event attribute to match on. Valid values are: `message`, `platform`, `environment`, `type`, `error.handled`, `error.unhandled`, `error.main_thread`, `exception.type`, `exception.value`, `user.id`, `user.email`, `user.username`, `user.ip_address`, `http.method`, `http.url`, `http.status_code`, `sdk.name`, `stacktrace.code`, `stacktrace.module`, `stacktrace.filename`, `stacktrace.abs_path`, `stacktrace.package`, `unreal.crash_type`, `app.in_foreground`.<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_attribute",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "match": "co",<br>                    "value": "bar",<br>                    "attribute": "message"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Tagged Event**<br>        The event's tags `key` match `value`<br>        - `key`: The tag value<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "tagged_event",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "key": "level",<br>                    "match": "eq",<br>                    "value": "error"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Latest Release**<br>        The event is from the latest release<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_release",<br>                "comparison": true,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Release Age**<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_adopted_release",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "environment": "production",<br>                    "ageComparison": "older",<br>                    "releaseAgeType": "oldest"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Level**<br>        The event's level is `match` `level`<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `eq`: Equal<br>            - `gte`: Greater than or equal<br>            - `lte`: Less than or equal<br>        - `level`: The event level<br>            - `50`: Fatal<br>            - `40`: Error<br>            - `30`: Warning<br>            - `20`: Info<br>            - `10`: Debug<br>            - `0`: Sample<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "level",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "level": 50,<br>                    "match": "eq"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Actions<br>        A list of actions that take place when all required conditions and filters for the alert are met. See below for a list of possible actions.<br><br><br>        **Notify on Preferred Channel**<br>        - `data`: A dictionary with the fallthrough type option when choosing to notify Suggested Assignees. Leave empty if notifying a user or team.<br>            - `fallthroughType`<br>                - `ActiveMembers`<br>                - `AllMembers`<br>                - `NoOne`<br>        - `config`: A dictionary with the configuration options for notification.<br>            - `targetType`: The type of recipient to notify<br>                - `user`: User<br>                - `team`: Team<br>                - `issue_owners`: Suggested Assignees<br>            - `targetDisplay`: null<br>            - `targetIdentifier`: The id of the user or team to notify. Leave null for Suggested Assignees.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{},<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"user",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"232692"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            },<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{<br>                    "fallthroughType":"ActiveMembers"<br>                },<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"issue_owners",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":""}<br>                ,<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        **Notify on Slack**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the channel to notify in.<br>        `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"slack",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on PagerDuty**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The severity level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"pagerduty",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"default"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Discord**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["tags"]`: Comma separated list of tags to add to the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"discord",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"12345",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"1234",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "tags":"transaction,environment"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on MSTeams**<br>        - `targetIdentifier` - The integration ID associated with the Microsoft Teams team.<br>        - `targetDisplay` - The name of the channel to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"msteams",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"19:a4b3kghaghgkjah357y6847@thread.skype",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on OpsGenie**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the Opsgenie team.<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the Opsgenie team to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The priority level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"opsgenie",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456-Error-Service",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"P3"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Azure DevOps**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"vsts",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira ticket**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"jira",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira Server ticket**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"jira_server",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a GitHub issue**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"github",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                  "additional_fields": {<br>                      "assignee": "",<br>                      "integration": "2345",<br>                      "labels": [],<br>                      "repo": "example-repo",<br>                  },<br>                  "dynamic_form_fields": [<br>                      {<br>                        "choices": [["YourOrg/example-repo", "example-repo"]],<br>                        "default": "YourOrg/example-repo",<br>                        "label": "GitHub Repository",<br>                        "name": "repo",<br>                        "required": true<br>                        "type": "select",<br>                        "updatesForm": true,<br>                        "url": "/extensions/github/search/example-repo/1234567/",<br>                      },<br>                  ],<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        |
|» » id|body|integer|false|none|
|» » logic_type|body|string|true|* `any`<br>* `any-short`<br>* `all`<br>* `none`|
|» » conditions|body|[object]|false|none|
