### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slug|string|false|none|The new slug for the organization, which needs to be unique.|
|name|string|false|none|The new name for the organization.|
|isEarlyAdopter|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to opt-in to new features before they're released to the public.|
|hideAiFeatures|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to hide AI features from the organization.|
|defaultRole|string|false|none|The default role new members will receive.<br><br>* `member` - Member<br>* `admin` - Admin<br>* `manager` - Manager<br>* `owner` - Owner|
|openMembership|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow organization members to freely join any team.|
|eventsMemberAdmin|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow members to delete events (including the delete & discard action) by granting them the `event:admin` scope.|
|alertsMemberWrite|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow members to create, edit, and delete alert rules by granting them the `alerts:write` scope.|
|attachmentsRole|string|false|none|The role required to download event attachments, such as native crash reports or log files.<br><br>* `member` - Member<br>* `admin` - Admin<br>* `manager` - Manager<br>* `owner` - Owner|
|debugFilesRole|string|false|none|The role required to download debug information files, ProGuard mappings and source maps.<br><br>* `member` - Member<br>* `admin` - Admin<br>* `manager` - Manager<br>* `owner` - Owner|
|hasGranularReplayPermissions|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to enable granular replay permissions, allowing per-member access control for replay data.|
|replayAccessMembers|[integer]|false|none|A list of user IDs who have permission to access replay data. Requires the hasGranularReplayPermissions flag to be true to be enforced.|
|avatarType|string|false|none|The type of display picture for the organization.<br><br>* `letter_avatar` - Use initials<br>* `upload` - Upload an image|
|avatar|string|false|none|The image to upload as the organization avatar, in base64. Required if `avatarType` is `upload`.|
|require2FA|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to require and enforce two-factor authentication for all members.|
|allowSharedIssues|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow sharing of limited details on issues to anonymous users.|
|enhancedPrivacy|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to enable enhanced privacy controls to limit personally identifiable information (PII) as well as source code in things like notifications.|
|scrapeJavaScript|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow Sentry to scrape missing JavaScript source context when possible.|
|storeCrashReports|integer|false|none|How many native crash reports (such as Minidumps for improved processing and download in issue details) to store per issue.<br><br>* `0` - Disabled<br>* `1` - 1 per issue<br>* `5` - 5 per issue<br>* `10` - 10 per issue<br>* `20` - 20 per issue<br>* `50` - 50 per issue<br>* `100` - 100 per issue<br>* `-1` - Unlimited|
|allowJoinRequests|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow users to request to join your organization.|
|dataScrubber|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to require server-side data scrubbing for all projects.|
|dataScrubberDefaults|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to apply the default scrubbers to prevent things like passwords and credit cards from being stored for all projects.|
|sensitiveFields|[string]|false|none|A list of additional global field names to match against when scrubbing data for all projects.|
|safeFields|[string]|false|none|A list of global field names which data scrubbers should ignore.|
|scrubIPAddresses|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to prevent IP addresses from being stored for new events on all projects.|
|relayPiiConfig|string|false|none|Advanced data scrubbing rules that can be configured for each project as a JSON string. The new rules will only apply to new incoming events. For more details on advanced data scrubbing, see our [full documentation](/security-legal-pii/scrubbing/advanced-datascrubbing/).<br><br>> Warning: Calling this endpoint with this field fully overwrites the advanced data scrubbing rules.<br><br>Below is an example of a payload for a set of advanced data scrubbing rules for masking credit card numbers from the log message (equivalent to `[Mask] [Credit card numbers] from [$message]` in the Sentry app) and removing a specific key called `foo` (equivalent to `[Remove] [Anything] from [extra.foo]` in the Sentry app):<br>```json<br>{<br>    relayPiiConfig: "{\"rules":{\"0\":{\"type\":\"creditcard\",\"redaction\":{\"method\":\"mask\"}},\"1\":{\"type\":\"anything\",\"redaction\":{\"method\":\"remove\"}}},\"applications\":{\"$message\":[\"0\"],\"extra.foo\":[\"1\"]}}"<br>}<br>```<br>        |
|trustedRelays|[object]|false|none|A list of local Relays (the name, public key, and description as a JSON) registered for the organization. This feature is only available for organizations on the Business and Enterprise plans. Read more about Relay [here](/product/relay/).<br><br>                                          Below is an example of a list containing a single local Relay registered for the organization:<br>                                          ```json<br>                                          {<br>                                            trustedRelays: [<br>                                                {<br>                                                    name: "my-relay",<br>                                                    publicKey: "eiwr9fdruw4erfh892qy4493reyf89ur34wefd90h",<br>                                                    description: "Configuration for my-relay."<br>                                                }<br>                                            ]<br>                                          }<br>                                          ```<br>                                          |
|relayDsnEndpoint|string \| null|false|none|A Relay base URL to use when displaying Client Key DSNs for this organization.|
|issueAlertsThreadFlag|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow the Sentry Slack integration to post replies in threads for an Issue Alert notification. Requires a Slack integration.|
|metricAlertsThreadFlag|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to allow the Sentry Slack integration to post replies in threads for a Metric Alert notification. Requires a Slack integration.|
|cancelDeletion|boolean|false|none|Specify `true` to restore an organization that is pending deletion.|
|apdexThreshold|integer|false|none|Deprecated. Response-time threshold in milliseconds previously used to compute Apdex.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|email|string(email)|true|none|The email address to send the invitation to.|
|role|string|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated, use `orgRole`. The organization-level role to assign.<br><br>* `member` - Member<br>* `admin` - Admin<br>* `manager` - Manager<br>* `owner` - Owner|
|orgRole|string|false|none|The organization-level role of the new member. Roles include:<br><br>* `billing` - Can manage payment and compliance details.<br>* `member` - Can view and act on events, as well as view most other data within the organization.<br>* `manager` - Has full management access to all teams and projects. Can also manage<br>        the organization's membership.<br>* `owner` - Has unrestricted access to the organization, its data, and its<br>        settings. Can add, modify, and delete projects and members, as well as<br>        make billing and plan changes.<br>* `admin` - Can edit global integrations, manage projects, and add/remove teams.<br>        They automatically assume the Team Admin role for teams they join.<br>        Note: This role can no longer be assigned in Business and Enterprise plans. Use `TeamRoles` instead.<br>        |
|teams|[object]|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated, use `teamRoles`. Slugs of teams to add the member to.|
|teamRoles|[object]|false|none|The team and team-roles assigned to the member. Team roles can be either:<br>        - `contributor` - Can view and act on issues. Depending on organization settings, they can also add team members.<br>        - `admin` - Has full management access to their team's membership and projects.|
|sendInvite|boolean|false|write-only|Whether or not to send an invite notification through email. Defaults to True.|
|reinvite|boolean|false|none|Whether or not to re-invite a user who has already been invited to the organization. Defaults to True.|
|regenerate|boolean|false|none|Reissue the invite token, invalidating any previously sent invite link.|


### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ref|string \| null|false|none|An optional commit reference. This is useful if a tagged version has been provided.|
|url|string(uri) \| null|false|none|A URL that points to the release. For instance, this can be the path to an online interface to the source code, such as a GitHub URL.|
|dateReleased|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|An optional date that indicates when the release went live.  If not provided the current time is used.|
|commits|[object]|false|none|An optional list of commit data to be associated.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the release. Can be `open` or `archived`.|
|headCommits|[object]|false|none|Deprecated, use `commits`. Head commits to associate with the release.|
|refs|[object]|false|none|An optional way to indicate the start and end commits for each repository included in a release. Head commits must include parameters ``repository`` and ``commit`` (the HEAD SHA). For GitLab repositories, please use the Group name instead of the slug. They can optionally include ``previousCommit`` (the SHA of the HEAD of the previous release), which should be specified if this is the first time you've sent commit data.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|digestsMinDelay|integer|true|none|Minimum time in seconds to wait before sending an issue digest email.|
|digestsMaxDelay|integer|true|none|Maximum time in seconds to wait before sending an issue digest email.|
|securityToken|string|true|none|Token sent with security reports (CSP, Expect-CT, HPKP) so Sentry can verify their origin.|
|securityTokenHeader|string|true|none|Name of the header carrying the security token on inbound security reports.|
|isBookmarked|boolean|false|none|Enables starring the project within the projects tab. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|autofixAutomationTuning|string|false|none|How aggressively Seer runs Autofix on new issues. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.<br><br>* `off`<br>* `super_low`<br>* `low`<br>* `medium`<br>* `high`<br>* `always`|
|seerScannerAutomation|boolean|false|none|Let Seer scan new issues automatically. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSizeStatusChecksEnabled|boolean|false|none|Enable preprod size status checks. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSizeStatusChecksRules|object|false|none|Rules controlling when preprod size status checks fail. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSizePrCommentsEnabled|boolean|false|none|Enable preprod size PR comments. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSizePrCommentsRules|object|false|none|Rules controlling which preprod size changes are posted as PR comments. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSnapshotStatusChecksEnabled|boolean|false|none|Enable preprod snapshot status checks.|
|preprodSnapshotStatusChecksFailOnAdded|boolean|false|none|Fail the preprod snapshot status check when snapshots are added.|
|preprodSnapshotStatusChecksFailOnRemoved|boolean|false|none|Fail the preprod snapshot status check when snapshots are removed.|
|preprodSnapshotStatusChecksFailOnChanged|boolean|false|none|Fail the preprod snapshot status check when snapshots change.|
|preprodSnapshotStatusChecksFailOnRenamed|boolean|false|none|Fail the preprod snapshot status check when snapshots are renamed.|
|preprodSizeEnabledByCustomer|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable preprod size analysis. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodDistributionEnabledByCustomer|boolean \| null|false|none|Enable preprod build distribution. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodDistributionPrCommentsEnabledByCustomer|boolean \| null|false|none|Post preprod distribution updates as PR comments. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodSnapshotPrCommentsEnabled|boolean \| null|false|none|Post preprod snapshot changes as PR comments.|
|preprodSnapshotPrCommentsPostOnAdded|boolean \| null|false|none|Include added snapshots in preprod snapshot PR comments.|
|preprodSnapshotPrCommentsPostOnRemoved|boolean \| null|false|none|Include removed snapshots in preprod snapshot PR comments.|
|preprodSnapshotPrCommentsPostOnChanged|boolean \| null|false|none|Include changed snapshots in preprod snapshot PR comments.|
|preprodSnapshotPrCommentsPostOnRenamed|boolean \| null|false|none|Include renamed snapshots in preprod snapshot PR comments.|
|preprodSizeEnabledQuery|string \| null|false|none|Query selecting which preprod builds are size-analyzed. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|preprodDistributionEnabledQuery|string \| null|false|none|Query selecting which preprod builds are distributed. Can be updated with **`project:read`** permission.|
|name|string|false|none|The name for the project|
|slug|string|false|none|Uniquely identifies a project and is used for the interface.|
|platform|string \| null|false|none|The platform for the project|
|subjectPrefix|string|false|none|Custom prefix for emails from this project.|
|subjectTemplate|string|false|none|The email subject to use (excluding the prefix) for individual alerts. Here are the list of variables you can use:<br>- `$title`<br>- `$shortID`<br>- `$projectID`<br>- `$orgID`<br>- `${tag:key}` - such as `${tag:environment}` or `${tag:release}`.|
|resolveAge|integer \| null|false|none|Automatically resolve an issue if it hasn't been seen for this many hours. Set to `0` to disable auto-resolve.|
|highlightContext|object|false|none|A JSON mapping of context types to lists of strings for their keys.<br>E.g. `{'user': ['id', 'email']}`|
|highlightTags|[string]|false|none|A list of strings with tag keys to highlight on this project's issues.<br>E.g. `['release', 'environment']`|
|verifySSL|boolean|false|none|Verify SSL certificates when delivering outbound webhooks and service hooks.|
|defaultEnvironment|string \| null|false|none|Environment selected by default when viewing this project.|
|dataScrubber|boolean|false|none|Remove known sensitive values from events before storing them.|
|dataScrubberDefaults|boolean|false|none|Also scrub Sentry's built-in list of sensitive field names.|
|sensitiveFields|[string]|false|none|Additional field names to scrub from events, beyond the defaults.|
|safeFields|[string]|false|none|Field names to exempt from scrubbing, including the built-in defaults.|
|storeCrashReports|integer \| null|false|none|Number of native crash report files to store per issue. Use `-1` for unlimited or `0` to store none.|
|relayPiiConfig|string \| null|false|none|Advanced data scrubbing rules, as a JSON string, applied before events are stored.|
|builtinSymbolSources|[string]|false|none|Identifiers of Sentry-hosted symbol sources to use when symbolicating events.|
|symbolSources|string \| null|false|none|Custom symbol sources, as a JSON string, to use when symbolicating events.|
|enableNativeSourceServerMapping|boolean|false|none|Apply source server (srcsrv) information from native debug files to symbolicated frames.|
|scrubIPAddresses|boolean|false|none|Discard client IP addresses rather than storing them on events.|
|groupingConfig|string \| null|false|none|Identifier of the grouping algorithm used to assign events to issues.|
|groupingEnhancements|string \| null|false|none|Grouping enhancement rules, as a newline-delimited config string, adjusting which stack frames contribute to an issue.|
|fingerprintingRules|string \| null|false|none|Fingerprinting rules, as a newline-delimited config string, controlling how events are grouped into issues.|
|secondaryGroupingConfig|string \| null|false|none|Grouping algorithm run alongside the primary one during a grouping migration.|
|secondaryGroupingExpiry|integer \| null|false|none|Unix timestamp after which the secondary grouping algorithm stops running.|
|scrapeJavaScript|boolean|false|none|Allow Sentry to fetch source files and source maps from your servers.|
|enableAutoReleaseCreation|boolean|false|none|Automatically create releases from ingested events. When disabled, releases must be created manually (e.g. via the Sentry CLI).|
|allowedDomains|[string]|false|none|Origins permitted to send events to this project. Use `*` to allow any.|
|copy_from_project|integer|false|none|ID of a project whose settings, teams, and keys should be copied into this one.|
|targetSampleRate|number(double)|false|none|Target proportion of transactions to retain, from `0` to `1`. Requires manual dynamic sampling mode.|
|dynamicSamplingBiases|[object]|false|none|Per-bias toggles adjusting which transactions dynamic sampling favors retaining.|
|tempestFetchScreenshots|boolean|false|none|Fetch screenshots attached to console crash reports. Requires the Tempest feature.|
|scmSourceContextEnabled|boolean|false|none|Enable on-demand source context fetching from SCM integrations for stack traces.|
|debugFilesRole|string \| null|false|none|The role required to download debug information files, ProGuard mappings and source maps. If not set, inherits from organization setting.<br><br>* `member` - Member<br>* `admin` - Admin<br>* `manager` - Manager<br>* `owner` - Owner|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|autofixAutomationTuning|off|
|autofixAutomationTuning|super_low|
|autofixAutomationTuning|low|
|autofixAutomationTuning|medium|
|autofixAutomationTuning|high|
|autofixAutomationTuning|always|
|debugFilesRole|member|
|debugFilesRole|admin|
|debugFilesRole|manager|
|debugFilesRole|owner|
|debugFilesRole|null|

```json
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|raw|string|false|none|Raw input for ownership configuration. See the [Ownership Rules Documentation](/product/issues/ownership-rules/) to learn more.|
|fallthrough|boolean|false|none|A boolean determining who to assign ownership to when an ownership rule has no match. If set to `True`, all project members are made owners. Otherwise, no owners are set.|
|autoAssignment|string|false|none|Auto-assignment settings. The available options are:<br>- Auto Assign to Issue Owner<br>- Auto Assign to Suspect Commits<br>- Turn off Auto-Assignment|
|codeownersAutoSync|boolean|false|none|Set to `True` to sync issue owners with CODEOWNERS updates in a release.|

```json
{
  "count": 0,
  "window": 0
}
```

Applies a rate limit to cap the number of errors accepted during a given time window. To
disable entirely set `rateLimit` to null.
```json
{
    "rateLimit": {
        "window": 7200, // time in seconds
        "count": 1000 // error cap
    }
}
```

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|count|integer \| null|false|none|none|
|window|integer \| null|false|none|none|

The endpoints read the upload directly off ``request.data``; this serializer

```json
{
  "type": "http",
  "name": "string",
  "id": "string",
  "layout": {
    "type": "native",
    "casing": "lowercase"
  },
  "filters": {
    "filetypes": [
      "pe"
    ],
    "path_patterns": [
      "string"
    ],
    "requires_checksum": true
  },
  "url": "string",
  "username": "string",
  "password": "string",
  "bucket": "string",
  "region": "us-east-2",
  "access_key": "string",
  "secret_key": "string",
  "prefix": "string",
  "client_email": "string",
  "private_key": "string",
  "account": "string",
  "container": "string",
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "client_id": "string",
  "client_secret": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the source.<br><br>* `http` - SymbolServer (HTTP)<br>* `gcs` - Google Cloud Storage<br>* `s3` - Amazon S3<br>* `azure` - Azure Blob Storage|
|name|string|true|none|The human-readable name of the source.|
|id|string|false|none|The internal ID of the source. Must be distinct from all other source IDs and cannot start with '`sentry:`'. If this is not provided, a new UUID will be generated.|
|layout|object|false|none|Layout settings for the source. This is required for HTTP, GCS, and S3 sources.<br><br>**`type`** ***(string)*** - The layout of the folder structure. The options are:<br>- `native` - Platform-Specific (SymStore / GDB / LLVM)<br>- `symstore` - Microsoft SymStore<br>- `symstore_index2` - Microsoft SymStore (with index2.txt)<br>- `ssqp` - Microsoft SSQP<br>- `unified` - Unified Symbol Server Layout<br>- `debuginfod` - debuginfod<br>- `nxsymstore` - Nintendo NXSymStore<br><br>**`casing`** ***(string)*** - The layout of the folder structure. The options are:<br>- `default` - Default (mixed case)<br>- `uppercase` - Uppercase<br>- `lowercase` - Lowercase<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "layout": {<br>        "type": "native"<br>        "casing": "default"<br>    }<br>}<br>```|
|filters|object|false|none|Filter settings for the source. This is optional for all sources.<br><br>**`filetypes`** ***(list)*** - A list of file types that can be found on this source. If this is left empty, all file types will be enabled. The options are:<br>- `pe` - Windows executable files<br>- `pdb` - Windows debug files<br>- `portablepdb` - .NET portable debug files<br>- `mach_code` - MacOS executable files<br>- `mach_debug` - MacOS debug files<br>- `elf_code` - ELF executable files<br>- `elf_debug` - ELF debug files<br>- `wasm_code` - WASM executable files<br>- `wasm_debug` - WASM debug files<br>- `breakpad` - Breakpad symbol files<br>- `sourcebundle` - Source code bundles<br>- `uuidmap` - Apple UUID mapping files<br>- `bcsymbolmap` - Apple bitcode symbol maps<br>- `il2cpp` - Unity IL2CPP mapping files<br>- `proguard` - ProGuard mapping files<br><br>**`path_patterns`** ***(list)*** - A list of glob patterns to check against the debug and code file paths of debug files. Only files that match one of these patterns will be requested from the source. If this is left empty, no path-based filtering takes place.<br><br>**`requires_checksum`** ***(boolean)*** - Whether this source requires a debug checksum to be sent with each request. Defaults to `false`.<br><br>```json<br>{<br>    "filters": {<br>        "filetypes": ["pe", "pdb", "portablepdb"],<br>        "path_patterns": ["*ffmpeg*"]<br>    }<br>}<br>```|
|url|string|false|none|The source's URL. Optional for HTTP sources, invalid for all others.|
|username|string|false|none|The user name for accessing the source. Optional for HTTP sources, invalid for all others.|
|password|string|false|none|The password for accessing the source. Optional for HTTP sources, invalid for all others.|
|bucket|string|false|none|The GCS or S3 bucket where the source resides. Required for GCS and S3 source, invalid for HTTP sources.|
|region|string|false|none|The source's [S3 region](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/s3.html). Required for S3 sources, invalid for all others.<br><br>* `us-east-2` - US East (Ohio)<br>* `us-east-1` - US East (N. Virginia)<br>* `us-west-1` - US West (N. California)<br>* `us-west-2` - US West (Oregon)<br>* `ap-east-1` - Asia Pacific (Hong Kong)<br>* `ap-south-1` - Asia Pacific (Mumbai)<br>* `ap-northeast-2` - Asia Pacific (Seoul)<br>* `ap-southeast-1` - Asia Pacific (Singapore)<br>* `ap-southeast-2` - Asia Pacific (Sydney)<br>* `ap-northeast-1` - Asia Pacific (Tokyo)<br>* `ca-central-1` - Canada (Central)<br>* `cn-north-1` - China (Beijing)<br>* `cn-northwest-1` - China (Ningxia)<br>* `eu-central-1` - EU (Frankfurt)<br>* `eu-west-1` - EU (Ireland)<br>* `eu-west-2` - EU (London)<br>* `eu-west-3` - EU (Paris)<br>* `eu-north-1` - EU (Stockholm)<br>* `sa-east-1` - South America (São Paulo)<br>* `us-gov-east-1` - AWS GovCloud (US-East)<br>* `us-gov-west-1` - AWS GovCloud (US)|
|access_key|string|false|none|The [AWS Access Key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/security-creds.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys).Required for S3 sources, invalid for all others.|
|secret_key|string|false|none|The [AWS Secret Access Key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/security-creds.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys).Required for S3 sources, invalid for all others.|
|prefix|string|false|none|The GCS, Azure or [S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-prefixes.html) prefix. Optional for GCS, Azure and S3 sources, invalid for HTTP.|
|client_email|string|false|none|The GCS email address for authentication. Required for GCS sources, invalid for all others.|
|private_key|string|false|none|The GCS private key. Required for GCS sources if not using impersonated tokens. Invalid for all others.|
|account|string|false|none|The Azure storage account name. Required for Azure sources, invalid for all others.|
|container|string|false|none|The Azure blob container name. Required for Azure sources, invalid for all others.|
|tenant_id|string|false|none|The Microsoft Entra tenant ID. Required for Azure sources, invalid for all others.|
|client_id|string|false|none|The Microsoft Entra application (client) ID. Required for Azure sources, invalid for all others.|
|client_secret|string|false|none|The Microsoft Entra client secret. Required for Azure sources, invalid for all others.|

Can also manage<br>        the organization's membership.<br>* `owner` - Has unrestricted access to the organization, its data, and its<br>        settings. Can add, modify, and delete projects and members, as well as<br>        make billing and plan changes.<br>* `admin` - Can edit global integrations, manage projects, and add/remove teams.<br>        They automatically assume the Team Admin role for teams they join.<br>        Note: This role can no longer be assigned in Business and Enterprise plans. Use `TeamRoles` instead.<br>        |

Depending on organization settings, they can also add team members.<br>- `admin` - Has full management access to their team's membership and projects.<br>```json<br>{<br>    "teamRoles": [<br>        {<br>            "teamSlug": "ancient-gabelers",<br>            "role": "admin"<br>        },<br>        {<br>            "teamSlug": "powerful-abolitionist",<br>            "role": "contributor"<br>        }<br>    ]<br>}<br>```<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_WidgetLayout">WidgetLayout</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemawidgetlayout"></a>
<a id="schema_WidgetLayout"></a>
<a id="tocSwidgetlayout"></a>
<a id="tocswidgetlayout"></a>

```json
{
  "x": 0,
  "y": 0,
  "w": 1,
  "h": 1,
  "min_h": 1
}
```

Widget grid layout position and dimensions.

The dashboard uses a 6-column grid. Required keys: x, y, w, h, minH.
Constraints: x (0-5), y (>= 0), w (1-6), h (>= 1), minH (>= 1), and x + w <= 6.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|x|integer|true|none|Column position (0-indexed).|
|y|integer|true|none|Row position (0-indexed).|
|w|integer|true|none|Width in grid columns (1-6).|
|h|integer|true|none|Height in grid rows.|
|min_h|integer|true|none|Minimum height in grid rows.|

```json
  },
```

```json
    "id": 0,
    "logic_type": "any",

      null
    ]
  },
  "action_filters": [
    {
      "id": 0,
      "logic_type": "any",
      "conditions": [
        null
      ],

          "property1": null,
          "property2": null
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "owner": "string"

```

Allows parameters to be defined in snake case, but passed as camel case.

Errors are output in camel case.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the alert|
|id|string|false|none|The ID of the existing alert|
|enabled|boolean|false|none|Whether the alert is enabled or disabled|
|detector_ids|[integer]|false|none|The IDs of the monitors to connect this alert to. Use 'Fetch an Organization's Monitors' to find the IDs.|
|config|object|false|none|<br>        Typically the frequency at which the alert will fire, in minutes.<br><br>        - `0`: 0 minutes<br>        - `5`: 5 minutes<br>        - `10`: 10 minutes<br>        - `30`: 30 minutes<br>        - `60`: 1 hour<br>        - `180`: 3 hours<br>        - `720`: 12 hours<br>        - `1440`: 24 hours<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "frequency": 60<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        |
|environment|string \| null|false|none|The name of the environment for the alert to evaluate in|
|triggers|object|false|none|The conditions on which the alert will trigger. See available options below.<br>        ```json<br>        {<br>            "triggers": {<br>                "organizationId": "1",<br>                "logicType": "any-short",<br>                "conditions": [<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "first_seen_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "issue_resolved_trigger",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "reappeared_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "regression_event",<br>                        "comparison": true,<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    },<br>                    {<br>                        "type": "seer_activity_trigger",<br>                        "comparison": [<br>                            "rca_completed",<br>                            "solution_completed",<br>                            "coding_completed",<br>                            "pr_ready_for_review"<br>                        ],<br>                        "conditionResult": true<br>                    }<br>                ]<br>            }<br>        }<br>        ```<br>        |
|action_filters|[object]|false|none|The filters to run before the action will fire and the action(s) to fire.<br><br>        `logicType` can be one of `any-short`, `all`, or `none`.<br><br>        Below is a basic example. See below for all other options.<br><br>        ```json<br>            "actionFilters": [<br>                {<br>                    "logicType": "any",<br>                    "conditions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "type": "level",<br>                            "comparison": {<br>                                "level": 50,<br>                                "match": "eq"<br>                            },<br>                            "conditionResult": true<br>                        }<br>                    ],<br>                    "actions": [<br>                        {<br>                            "id": "123",<br>                            "type": "email",<br>                            "integrationId": null,<br>                            "data": {},<br>                            "config": {<br>                                "targetType": "user",<br>                                "targetDisplay": null,<br>                                "targetIdentifier": "56789"<br>                            },<br>                            "status": "active"<br>                        }<br>                    ]<br>                }<br>            ]<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Conditions<br><br>        **Issue Age**<br>        - `time`: One of `minute`, `hour`, `day`, or `week`.<br>        - `value`: A positive integer.<br>        - `comparisonType`: One of `older` or `newer`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "age_comparison",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "time": "minute",<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "comparisonType": "older"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Assignment**<br>        - `targetType`: Who the issue is assigned to<br>            - `Unassigned`: Unassigned<br>            - `Member`: Assigned to a user<br>            - `Team`: Assigned to a team<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the user or team from the `targetType`. Enter "" if `targetType` is `Unassigned`.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "assigned_to",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "targetType": "Member",<br>                    "targetIdentifier": 123456<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Category**<br>        - `value`: The issue category to filter to.<br>            - `1`: Error issues<br>            - `6`: Feedback issues<br>            - `10`: Outage issues<br>            - `11`: Metric issues<br>            - `12`: DB Query issues<br>            - `13`: HTTP Client issues<br>            - `14`: Front end issues<br>            - `15`: Mobile issues<br>            - `17`: Preprod issues<br>            - `19`: Configuration issues<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_category",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 1<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Frequency**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing how many times the issue has to happen before the alert will fire.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_occurrences",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **De-escalation**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority threshold the issue must de-escalate below.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_deescalating",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Issue Priority**<br>        - `comparison`: The priority the issue must be for the alert to fire.<br>            - `75`: High priority<br>            - `50`: Medium priority<br>            - `25`: Low priority<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "issue_priority_greater_or_equal",<br>                "comparison": 75,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Users Affected**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of users that must be affected before the alert will fire.<br>        - `filters`: A list of additional sub-filters to evaluate before the alert will fire.<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of users affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_unique_user_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "filters": [{"key": "foo", "match": "eq", "value": "bar"}],<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Number of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Number of events in an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percent of Events**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_frequency_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 100,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br><br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Count**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value. e.g. Percentage of sessions affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_count",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Percentage of Sessions Affected Percent**<br>        - `value`: A positive integer representing the number of events in an issue that must come in before the alert will fire<br>        - `interval`: The time period in which to evaluate the value.<br>            - `1m`: 1 minute<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `10m`: 10 minutes<br>            - `30m`: 30 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>        - `comparisonInterval`: The time period to compare against.<br>            - `5m`: 5 minutes<br>            - `15m`: 15 minutes<br>            - `1h`: 1 hour<br>            - `1d`: 1 day<br>            - `1w`: 1 week<br>            - `30d`: 30 days<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "percent_sessions_percent",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "value": 10,<br>                    "interval": "1h",<br>                    "comparisonInterval": "1w"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Attribute**<br>        The event's `attribute` value `match` `value`<br><br>        - `attribute`: The event attribute to match on. Valid values are: `message`, `platform`, `environment`, `type`, `error.handled`, `error.unhandled`, `error.main_thread`, `exception.type`, `exception.value`, `user.id`, `user.email`, `user.username`, `user.ip_address`, `http.method`, `http.url`, `http.status_code`, `sdk.name`, `stacktrace.code`, `stacktrace.module`, `stacktrace.filename`, `stacktrace.abs_path`, `stacktrace.package`, `unreal.crash_type`, `app.in_foreground`.<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "event_attribute",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "match": "co",<br>                    "value": "bar",<br>                    "attribute": "message"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Tagged Event**<br>        The event's tags `key` match `value`<br>        - `key`: The tag value<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `co`: Contains<br>            - `nc`: Does not contain<br>            - `eq`: Equals<br>            - `ne`: Does not equal<br>            - `sw`: Starts with<br>            - `ew`: Ends with<br>            - `is`: Is set<br>            - `ns`: Is not set<br>        - `value`: A string. Must be omitted when match is `is` or `ns`; required otherwise.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "tagged_event",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "key": "level",<br>                    "match": "eq",<br>                    "value": "error"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Latest Release**<br>        The event is from the latest release<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_release",<br>                "comparison": true,<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Release Age**<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "latest_adopted_release",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "environment": "production",<br>                    "ageComparison": "older",<br>                    "releaseAgeType": "oldest"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Event Level**<br>        The event's level is `match` `level`<br>        - `match`: The comparison operator<br>            - `eq`: Equal<br>            - `gte`: Greater than or equal<br>            - `lte`: Less than or equal<br>        - `level`: The event level<br>            - `50`: Fatal<br>            - `40`: Error<br>            - `30`: Warning<br>            - `20`: Info<br>            - `10`: Debug<br>            - `0`: Sample<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type": "level",<br>                "comparison": {<br>                    "level": 50,<br>                    "match": "eq"<br>                },<br>                "conditionResult": true<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        ## Actions<br>        A list of actions that take place when all required conditions and filters for the alert are met. See below for a list of possible actions.<br><br><br>        **Notify on Preferred Channel**<br>        - `data`: A dictionary with the fallthrough type option when choosing to notify Suggested Assignees. Leave empty if notifying a user or team.<br>            - `fallthroughType`<br>                - `ActiveMembers`<br>                - `AllMembers`<br>                - `NoOne`<br>        - `config`: A dictionary with the configuration options for notification.<br>            - `targetType`: The type of recipient to notify<br>                - `user`: User<br>                - `team`: Team<br>                - `issue_owners`: Suggested Assignees<br>            - `targetDisplay`: null<br>            - `targetIdentifier`: The id of the user or team to notify. Leave null for Suggested Assignees.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{},<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"user",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"232692"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            },<br>            {<br>                "type":"email",<br>                "integrationId":null,<br>                "data":{<br>                    "fallthroughType":"ActiveMembers"<br>                },<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"issue_owners",<br>                    "targetDisplay":null,<br>                    "targetIdentifier":""}<br>                ,<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        **Notify on Slack**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the channel to notify in.<br>        `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"slack",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on PagerDuty**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The severity level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"pagerduty",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"default"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Discord**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the service to create the ticket in.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["tags"]`: Comma separated list of tags to add to the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"discord",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"12345",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"1234",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "tags":"transaction,environment"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on MSTeams**<br>        - `targetIdentifier` - The integration ID associated with the Microsoft Teams team.<br>        - `targetDisplay` - The name of the channel to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"msteams",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"19:a4b3kghaghgkjah357y6847@thread.skype",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"notify-errors"<br>                },<br>                "integrationId":"1",<br>                "data":{},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on OpsGenie**<br>        - `targetDisplay`: The name of the Opsgenie team.<br>        - `targetIdentifier`: The ID of the Opsgenie team to send the notification to.<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data["priority"]`: The priority level for the notification.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"opsgenie",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":"123456-Error-Service",<br>                    "targetDisplay":"Error Service"<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                    "priority":"P3"<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Notify on Azure DevOps**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"vsts",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira ticket**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"jira",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a Jira Server ticket**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"jira_server",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{...},<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br><br>        **Create a GitHub issue**<br>        - `integrationId`: The stringified ID of the integration.<br>        - `data` - A list of any fields you want to include in the ticket as objects.<br><br>        ```json<br>            {<br>                "type":"github",<br>                "config":{<br>                    "targetType":"specific",<br>                    "targetIdentifier":",<br>                    "targetDisplay":""<br>                    },<br>                "integrationId":"2345",<br>                "data":{<br>                  "additional_fields": {<br>                      "assignee": "",<br>                      "integration": "2345",<br>                      "labels": [],<br>                      "repo": "example-repo",<br>                  },<br>                  "dynamic_form_fields": [<br>                      {<br>                        "choices": [["YourOrg/example-repo", "example-repo"]],<br>                        "default": "YourOrg/example-repo",<br>                        "label": "GitHub Repository",<br>                        "name": "repo",<br>                        "required": true<br>                        "type": "select",<br>                        "updatesForm": true,<br>                        "url": "/extensions/github/search/example-repo/1234567/",<br>                      },<br>                  ],<br>                },<br>                "status":"active"<br>            }<br>        ```<br>        |
|owner|string \| null|false|none|<br>            The ID user or team who owns the monitor or alert prefaced by the string 'user' or 'team'.<br><br>            **User**<br>            ```json<br>                "user:123456"<br>            ```<br><br>            **Team**<br>            ```json<br>                "team:456789"<br>            ```<br>        |

<h2 id="tocS__LegacyBrowserFilter">_LegacyBrowserFilter</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schema_legacybrowserfilter"></a>
<a id="schema__LegacyBrowserFilter"></a>
<a id="tocS_legacybrowserfilter"></a>
<a id="tocs_legacybrowserfilter"></a>

```json
{
  "active": true,
  "subfilters": [
    "ie"
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|active|boolean|false|none|Toggle the browser-extensions, localhost, filtered-transaction, or web-crawlers filter on or off.|
|subfilters|[string]|false|none|<br>Specifies which legacy browser filters should be active. Anything excluded from the list will be<br>disabled. The options are:<br>- `ie` - Internet Explorer Version 11 and lower<br>- `edge` - Edge Version 110 and lower<br>- `safari` - Safari Version 15 and lower<br>- `firefox` - Firefox Version 110 and lower<br>- `chrome` - Chrome Version 110 and lower<br>- `opera` - Opera Version 99 and lower<br>- `android` - Android Version 3 and lower<br>- `opera_mini` - Opera Mini Version 34 and lower<br><br>Deprecated options:<br>- `ie_pre_9` - Internet Explorer Version 8 and lower<br>- `ie9` - Internet Explorer Version 9<br>- `ie10` - Internet Explorer Version 10<br>- `ie11` - Internet Explorer Version 11<br>- `safari_pre_6` - Safari Version 5 and lower<br>- `opera_pre_15` - Opera Version 14 and lower<br>- `opera_mini_pre_8` - Opera Mini Version 8 and lower<br>- `android_pre_4` - Android Version 3 and lower<br>- `edge_pre_79` - Edge Version 18 and lower (non Chromium based)<br>|
